context: The operator ruled (redesign :51-53, change 5): no new Build until the full RCF suite is green on the base, and specs cannot be verified mid-build; bundle --next refuses while the base suite is not green and never on verified. Q-01 a: "full suite green" means the RCF suites, not hygiene tests. Q-04 a: 0.37.0 bundles amend rounds on complete specs by touched criterion (register WA-10). The 0.36.x backstop held the queue on complete-not-verified specs through an opt-in rcf/define/backstop.json.
decision: The base suite is green when a BaseSuiteRecord for the current HEAD records exit code 0 and no failing TAP test. The record comes from rcf build base-suite, run by the stage-keeper on the committed base with the project's RCF suite command (hygiene tests excluded, per Q-01); rcf build bundle reads it from --base-suite <file> and never runs the suite itself, so a bundle stays fast and the suite cost is paid once per base head. The backstop applies to every bundle, --next, explicit id and amend, and has no override. backstop.json, backstop adopt and --allow-unverified retire with exit 2 lines that name the replacement. An amend round is rcf build bundle <fbs-id> --acs <ids> on a complete or verified spec; the bundle lists only the touched criteria, the reviewer carries them into the ReviewVerdict touchedAcIds, and Finalise scopes test strength and Code Nodes to them.
consequences: verified never gates a Build; a red base does. A stage-keeper who forgets to record the base suite is told the exact command. The record is a local file named on the command line, not a chain record, so it never collides between branches. WA-10 retires once this lands; WA-08 (explicit-id bundling while readiness is red) is the readiness slice's.

alternativesConsidered.name: Bundle runs the suite itself
alternativesConsidered.summary: rcf build bundle --next runs the RCF suite before emitting.
alternativesConsidered.reasonNotChosen: Minutes per bundle (166 seconds for this repository's suite at concurrency 6 on the DEFINE host), paid again on every bundle at the same base.

alternativesConsidered.name: Trust a named CI run on the base
alternativesConsidered.summary: A --base-ci <ref> recorded without fetching, like Finalise's --ci-run.
alternativesConsidered.reasonNotChosen: A downstream product's CI may not run the RCF suite; a local record names the exact command and head. Kept as an open question.

alternativesConsidered.name: The TEST verdict of the last merged round
alternativesConsidered.summary: Use the newest TestVerdict on the base.
alternativesConsidered.reasonNotChosen: It names the round's reviewed head, not the merge commit on the base, and other merges may have landed since.

title: The backstop is the RCF suite green on the base, from a recorded run at the base head; amend rounds bundle by touched criterion
